title: Administrative login
subtitle: restricted access for parameter changes
heading: Sign in to administration
description: The public GreenER dashboard remains available. Changes require authorized access.
invalidCredentials: Email or password is incorrect. Check your details and try again.
forbidden: Access denied. Your account does not allow this action.
totpSetupDescription: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app and confirm a code to activate two-factor authentication.
totpChallengeDescription: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
totpManualWarning: Use this key in your authenticator app and do not share it.
totpCopyFailed: Couldn't copy the key. Select and copy the text manually.
totpSetupInvalidCode: Invalid code. Check your app and try again.
totpChallengeInvalidCode: Invalid or expired code. Try again.
totpGenericError: Couldn't verify the code. Try again.
totpExpired: The authentication step expired. Sign in again with your credentials.
totpRateLimited: There have been too many authentication attempts. Wait a while before trying again.
totpDelayed: Wait a moment before trying again.
ssoAcceptInvitation: Accept invitation and continue with Google
ssoErrorHeading: Could not sign in with Google
ssoFailed: Google sign-in could not be completed. Try again or sign in with email and password.
signInFailed: Could not sign in. Try again.
setupInvitationDescription: Enter your name and the email you will use to access the organization. We will send confirmation to that address.
setupConfirmationDescription: Confirm your email by creating a password for your account.
setupEmailSent: We sent a link to confirm your address and create your password. Check your spam folder too.
setupReadyDescription: Sign in with your email and password. On your first sign-in as an administrator, you will set up your authenticator app.
setupInvalidLink: This link is missing, expired or already used. Reopen the email link or ask the person who invited you for a new one.
setupEmailInUse: This email is already in use. Sign in to the existing account or use another address.
setupRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
setupFailed: We could not complete this step. Try again. If the problem continues, contact the person who invited you.
